_comment: Trigun watch order. Badlands Rumble (2010) is set after Vash has met the allies he has by early-to-mid series but before the later antagonists are introduced -- community consensus (fandomwire.com, thepopverse.com, myotakuworld.com, 2026-09-11 session) places it between episodes 10 and 11 of the 1998 series. Trigun Stampede (2023) is a separate reboot/reimagining, not a sequel -- deliberately excluded from this continuity playlist.
